record.Description:
This recall involves Magnetopia-branded Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks, which are magnetic cubes sold in sets of 60, 100, 150 and 200. The cubes contain small, powerful magnets that allow the cubes to stick together and create 3D designs. The sets are available in a variety of themed building/landscape designs and colors. The following styles and models are included in the recall:

Style Name	Model Number
Darkhouse	MAT-030
Arean	MAT-031
Darkgrass	MAT-032
Farmday	MAT-033
Bluehous	MAT-034
Pinkfarm	MAT-035
DarkForest	MAT-036
PinkHouse	MAT-037
Seafight	MAT-038
Firefarm	MAT-039
Darkfarm	MAT-040
Darkhouse	T009
BrownFarm	T025
Farm	T076
Darkhero	T078
The model numbers of the recalled cubes are located on the back of the product packaging.
record.Title: Magnetopia Recalls Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
record.ConsumerContact: Magnetopia by email at toyrecall78945@outlook.com or online at recall.magnetopia.com for more information.

Hazards.Name: The recalled magnetic building cubes contain magnets that can become loose if the cubes break or open, posing a magnet ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled magnetic building cubes immediately and contact Magnetopia for a full refund. Consumers will be provided with a pre-paid label to return the recalled magnetic cubes to receive a refund.
